memories.content: Bill believes the fence is shared property and that the Osei family should pay half of the repair cost. He is open to negotiation but prefers to avoid court. He has not yet formally proposed a split.

A storm has damaged a shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property. The fence is on the property line. Both parties are aware of the damage and have spoken briefly about it but have not agreed on a cost split. The cost to repair is estimated at $2,000. Small claims court is an option if no agreement is reached.
